bias.en: Downtrend · new low at $117.4, closed back above $122.2
bias.zh: 下跌趋势 · 创 $117.4 新低，收盘回到 $122.2 上方

read.en: The Nasdaq ADS rose 0.4% on Nov 17 to $122.61, trading $117.41–123.43 on light volume (0.65x the 20-day average). It is below the 5-day ($131.3), 10-day ($131.5) and 30-day ($144.6), all falling (no 100-day or 200-day yet, 92 sessions). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 16, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 5 ($158.69), and RSI is 38.0.
read.zh: 纳斯达克 ADS 11月17日上涨 0.4%，收于 $122.61，盘中区间 $117.41–123.43，成交量偏低（为 20 日均量的 0.65 倍）。股价位于 5 日（$131.3）、10 日（$131.5）和 30 日均线（$144.6）下方，三者均在下行（上市仅 92 个交易日，尚无 100、200 日均线）。MACD 自 11月16日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图放大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月5日起看空（$158.69），RSI 为 38.0。

read.en: The $117.41 low, the lowest since listing, broke through the $121.9 and $120 supports intraday, but the close recovered to just above the Nov 5 low ($122.20). Resistance is $123.4–123.9 (Nov 17 high, Nov 5 close), then $124.8–126 (Nov 6 low, Nov 16 high) and $127.3–129.7. Support is $122.2, then $120.5 (Nov 16 low) and $117.4 (Nov 17 low). A close above $123.9 would target $126; below $120.5, $117.4.

r.en: Nov 6 close $127.34; Nov 10 low $127.38; Nov 13 low $129.18; Nov 10 close $129.66

read.en: SK hynix's latest Seoul bar is flat at ₩1,098,000, carrying the Nov 16 close; that session fell 2.0% from ₩1,120,000, trading ₩1,092,000–1,150,000. The close is below the falling 5-day (₩1,157,200), 10-day (₩1,180,700), 30-day (₩1,327,300) and 100-day (₩1,687,800) and the rising 200-day (₩1,524,800). MACD has been below its signal since Nov 15, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 4 (₩1,443,400), and RSI is 34.8.

The Nov 16 close broke the ₩1,113,000–1,116,000 support (Nov 15 and Nov 8 lows), now resistance, while the ₩1,092,000 low held just above the Nov 5 low (₩1,089,000). Resistance is ₩1,113,000–1,120,000, then ₩1,132,000–1,150,000 (Nov 5 and 8 closes, Nov 16 high) and ₩1,157,200–1,171,000 (5-day, Oct 22 low). Support is ₩1,089,000–1,092,000, then ₩1,000,000. A close above ₩1,120,000 would target ₩1,150,000; below ₩1,089,000, ₩1,000,000.

r.en: Nov 15 low ₩1,113,000 and Nov 8 low ₩1,116,000, lost; Nov 15 close ₩1,120,000
